profile_isolation.how: USERPROFILE (plus cleared HOMEDRIVE/HOMEPATH) pointed at a fresh scratch dir before any project import; the project hard-codes os.path.expanduser('~') + '/.nedotify' with no override env var
profile_isolation.gui: never launched - webview.start() is not reached by any mode

raw.format: folded stacks, trailing number = self samples

sleep_and_wait_sites.note: measured_wake_hz = calls_observed / wake_log_observed_s; the last sleep in flight at process exit is counted as a call but contributes no blocked_s

sites.classification: timeout-bounded wait, 1 Hz (wakes on timeout even when idle)
